title: Path integral formulation of finite-dimensional quantum mechanics in discrete phase space
summary: We develop a path integral representation for the dynamics of quantum systems with a finite-dimensional Hilbert space, formulated entirely within a discrete phase space. Starting from the discrete Wigner function on ${\mathbb{Z}_d} \times {\mathbb{Z}_d}$ ($d$ an odd prime) and the associated Weyl transform built from generalized displacement operators, we derive an exact kernel that propagates the discrete Wigner function in time and, by iterating its composition law through a short-time approximation, obtain a sum-over-paths expression weighted by a discrete phase-space action -- the…
